v1-ring.label: Ring road — the full loop
v1-ring.note: The classic loop in six days. Covers the whole country but never lingers, and one night falls outside the camping card.

days.title: Airport to the Golden Circle
days.summary: Collect the car, pick up the third of you, and drive straight into the classics.
days.note: Shop in Selfoss — it is the last big supermarket before the south coast.

days.title: South coast waterfalls
days.summary: The postcard stretch, ending east of Vík.
days.note: An easy day now that nights are not limited to the card — the whole south coast in 200 km, with time at every stop.

days.title: Glaciers, the lagoon and the east
days.summary: The best day of the trip. Leave early.
days.note: Bragðavellir closes on 15 September, so this is one of its last nights — ring ahead.

days.title: Stuðlagil, Dettifoss and Mývatn
days.summary: Across the top of the country. The longest driving day.
days.note: The unavoidable monster. Djúpivogur to Húsavík is 450 km before you stop for anything, and there is no card campsite in between — this is the price of doing the whole ring in six days. Húsavík closes on 15 September, so tonight is its last: phone ahead before you commit to this plan.

days.title: Whales, then the long run west
days.summary: Split the morning in Húsavík, then transit to the west.

split.note: Both leave from the same harbour, about 100 m apart — regroup on the quay.

options.book: Walk in. Roughly a fifth of the boat price.

days.title: Back to the airport
days.summary: Short by design — the car has to be back before a 17:00 flight.
days.note: Aim to be at KEF by 15:00. Nothing on this leg is worth missing a flight for.

v2-ring-max.label: Ring road — maximum stops
v2-ring-max.note: Same loop and same nights, with every worthwhile quick stop within a couple of kilometres of the road. Long activities left out on purpose — the extra sights cost minutes, not hours.

days.title: Airport to the Golden Circle, every stop
days.summary: Collect the car, pick up the third of you, and drive straight into the classics.
days.note: Shop in Selfoss — it is the last big supermarket before the south coast.

days.title: Every waterfall on the south coast
days.summary: The postcard stretch, ending east of Vík.
days.note: An easy day now that nights are not limited to the card — the whole south coast in 200 km, with time at every stop.

days.title: Klaustur's roadside cluster, then the lagoon
days.summary: The best day of the trip. Leave early.
days.note: Bragðavellir closes on 15 September, so this is one of its last nights — ring ahead.

days.title: Stuðlagil, Dettifoss and the whole Mývatn loop
days.summary: Across the top of the country. The longest driving day.
days.note: The unavoidable monster. Djúpivogur to Húsavík is 450 km before you stop for anything, and there is no card campsite in between — this is the price of doing the whole ring in six days. Húsavík closes on 15 September, so tonight is its last: phone ahead before you commit to this plan.

days.title: Whales, Goðafoss and the northern back roads
days.summary: Split the morning in Húsavík, then transit to the west.

split.note: Both leave from the same harbour, about 100 m apart — regroup on the quay.

options.book: Walk in. Roughly a fifth of the boat price.

days.title: Reykholt and Borgarnes on the way to the plane
days.summary: Short by design — the car has to be back before a 17:00 flight.
days.note: Aim to be at KEF by 15:00. Nothing on this leg is worth missing a flight for.

v3-west-south.label: West & south — NOT a ring
v3-west-south.note: Drops the north and east to do Reykjanes, the Golden Circle, the south coast and all of Snæfellsnes properly. Far less driving, more stops, every night on the card. No Jökulsárlón, no whales.

days.title: Reykjanes, on the airport's doorstep
days.summary: The volcanic tip starts 20 minutes from the car hire desk.
days.note: CHECK safetravel.is AND road.is THIS MORNING — Reykjanes has erupted repeatedly since 2023 and these roads close at short notice. If shut, drive on to Seltún.

days.title: Golden Circle at its own pace
days.summary: The loop with time to spare, rather than a dash.
days.note: Þingvellir rewards an hour on foot rather than twenty minutes at the viewpoint.

days.title: South coast and back
days.summary: Out to Vík and back — the only out-and-back in any of these plans.
days.note: Going only as far as Vík is what buys Snæfellsnes later. Jökulsárlón is another 190 km east of the turnaround and simply does not fit this shape.

days.title: North to Snæfellsnes
days.summary: Across to Borgarfjörður, then out onto the peninsula.
days.note: Grundarfjörður closes on 15 September — tonight is its last. Ring ahead.

days.title: The whole Snæfellsnes loop
days.summary: The peninsula every 6-day ring plan skips entirely.
days.note: Snæfellsjökull's road is the one thing here that can be weather-closed; the coast road is fine.

days.title: Back to the airport
days.summary: Short by design — the car has to be back before a 17:00 flight.
days.note: Aim to be at KEF by 15:00.
